```{r}
#| code-summary: "Code: setup"
source("_common.R")
# read as text so that the reported values keep the decimals of the first submission
au <- read.csv(file.path(OUT, "tables", "audit_first_submission.csv"), colClasses = "character", na.strings = character(0), encoding = "UTF-8")
stopifnot(all(au$agrees %in% c("TRUE", "FALSE", "NA")))
ok <- au$agrees == "TRUE"; rec <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(au$recomputed))
au$recomputed <- ifelse(is.na(rec), au$recomputed, formatC(rec, format = "fg", digits = 6, flag = "#"))
```

## Run everything

From the root of the repository:

```sh
Rscript analysis/run_all.R        # tables, figures and results.json in analysis/output/
bash docs/render_report.sh        # these pages and docs/figures/ (optional; needs Quarto and the R package knitr)
```

The first command needs R (4.3 or later) and the packages `readstata13`, `dplyr`, `tidyr`, `car`, `sandwich`,
`ggplot2`, `patchwork` and `jsonlite`, plus the SWAN visit 10 file in `ICPSR_32961/DS0001/`, which must be obtained
from ICPSR. The pipeline never modifies the raw file. It stops if the primary model does not reproduce its expected
sample size, AIC and SHBG coefficient (n = `r fmt(S$n, 0)`, AIC `r fmt(PR$aic, 3)`), or if the initial model does not
reproduce the values of the model submitted originally (AIC `r fmt(SUB$aic, 3)`).

These pages do not refit any model. Every table, figure and number shown here is read from `analysis/output/`, so the
report, the manuscript and the supplementary files always agree with the pipeline.

## What each script produces

| Script | Purpose | Used in |
|:--|:----------|:-----|
| `analysis/config.R` | Paths, reporting units, SI conversion factors, reference categories, expected values of the primary and initial models | all scripts |
| `analysis/R/functions.R` | Definition of the primary and initial models, model fitting, ratios of means with confidence intervals, standardized means | all scripts |
| `R/01_prepare_data.R` | Reads the raw file, recodes, derives variables, checks the Janssen equation, defines the analytic sample, counts missing values | [Data and sample](data.html) |
| `R/02_descriptives.R` | Characteristics by tertile of SHBG, included vs not included, comparison by menopausal status, correlations, muscle mass by tertile of SHBG within tertiles of waist circumference | Table 1; Fig 1; Tables A to C and J in S1 File |
| `R/03_primary_model.R` | Primary gamma log-link model, initial model, adjusted means, diagnostics of both | Table 2; Tables E and H in S1 File; [Primary model](results.html) |
| `R/04_sensitivity.R` | Sequential adjustment, one covariate removed at a time, other measures of body size, scaling, specification, restrictions, shape of the association, full regression output | Fig 2; Tables D and I in S1 File |
| `R/05_model_comparison.R` | Distributions and link functions, other families, variance function | Table F in S1 File; [Diagnostics and model choice](diagnostics.html) |
| `R/06_shbg_as_outcome.R` | Complementary model with SHBG as the dependent variable, with the covariates of the primary model (ratios, joint tests, coefficients, fit measures) and of the initial model | Table 3; Tables G and I in S1 File |
| `R/07_figures.R` | Figures as 600 dpi TIFF with PNG previews | Fig 1, Fig 2; Figs A to D in S1 File |
| `R/08_audit_first_submission.R` | Recomputes the numbers reported in the first submission | this page |
| `R/09_export_results.R` | Collects every number quoted in the text into `results.json`; writes the session information | manuscript text, these pages |
| `R/10_check_formulas.R` | Computes by hand the formulas of Text A in S1 File and of [Model definition](models.html) and stops if any differs from what R returns | Text A in S1 File; table below |

## Code of the pipeline

The scripts as they are in [`analysis/`](https://github.com/AmaruSimonAgueroJimenez/SWAN/tree/main/analysis), in the
order in which `run_all.R` runs them. They are shown folded and are not run when these pages are rendered.

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
show_code("analysis/run_all.R", "analysis/config.R", "analysis/R/functions.R", "analysis/R/01_prepare_data.R", "analysis/R/02_descriptives.R",
          "analysis/R/03_primary_model.R", "analysis/R/04_sensitivity.R", "analysis/R/05_model_comparison.R", "analysis/R/06_shbg_as_outcome.R",
          "analysis/R/07_figures.R", "analysis/R/08_audit_first_submission.R", "analysis/R/09_export_results.R", "analysis/R/10_check_formulas.R")
```

On every page of this report the code of each table is folded above it (*Code*). That code reads the output of the
pipeline with the helpers of `docs/_common.R`:

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
show_code("docs/_common.R")
```

## Figures of the manuscript

The two figures of the main text are written by the pipeline to `analysis/output/figures/` and copied to
`docs/figures/` when the report is rendered: [Fig1.png](figures/Fig1.png), [Fig1.tif](figures/Fig1.tif),
[Fig2.png](figures/Fig2.png) and [Fig2.tif](figures/Fig2.tif). The TIFF files (600 dpi, LZW) are the ones to upload
to the journal.

## Check of the formulas

The equations of Text A in S1 File and of [Model definition](models.html) are computed by hand from the design matrix,
the outcome and the fitted values of the primary model, and compared with the values that R returns.

```{r}
fc <- tab("tableS_formula_checks")
stopifnot(all(fc$agrees))
kt(data.frame(Equation = fc$equation, Quantity = fc$quantity, `Largest absolute difference` = formatC(fc$max_abs_difference, format = "e", digits = 1),
              Tolerance = formatC(fc$tolerance, format = "e", digits = 0), Agrees = ifelse(fc$agrees, "yes", "no"), check.names = FALSE), align = "llrrl")
```

Equation numbers are those of Text A in S1 File. The score equations hold up to the convergence tolerance of the
fitting algorithm.

## History of the primary model

The model submitted originally (called the initial model here) had SHBG and the hormones on their original scale and
percent body fat as the only measure of body composition. On 17 November 2026 it was replaced as the primary model by
the model defined in [Model definition](models.html), which adds height, waist circumference and race/ethnicity, uses
base 2 logarithms for SHBG and the hormones and drops percent body fat. The change was made after the results of the
initial model were known. The initial model is still fitted by the pipeline, with its own regression test, and is
reported in full. The script that led to the proposal is kept in `analysis/proposal/`:

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
show_code("analysis/proposal/primary_model_proposal.R")
```

## Audit of the first submission

The numbers reported in the version of the manuscript that was submitted first were recomputed from the data.
`r sum(ok)` of `r nrow(au)` items agree; the others are listed first.

```{r}
o <- order(ok)
kt(data.frame(Item = au$item, Reported = ifelse(au$reported == "NA", "not stated", au$reported), Recomputed = au$recomputed,
              Agrees = ifelse(au$agrees == "TRUE", "yes", ifelse(au$agrees == "FALSE", "no", "not comparable")),
              Comment = au$comment, check.names = FALSE)[o, ], align = "lrrll")
```

## Data terms

The SWAN data are distributed by ICPSR under its terms of use. Anyone who wants to reproduce the analysis should
download the visit 10 file (study 32961, version 2) from ICPSR and place it in `ICPSR_32961/DS0001/`.
